extra.abstract_snippet: Abstract The functional brain activity network is the result of the harmonious activity of different regions. Each harmonic activity requires feedback from different areas of activity to adjust itself. As a result, any disorder in this harmony can affect the functional brain activity network. In this study, we use transfer entropy (TE) to examine the information transfer patterns of brain activity in Healthy Controls (HC) and individuals with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD).
